title: Feature 023 draft fragment: script node language enum (additive IR v1)
description: Not canonical. T023-051 merges the four new values into both `script.language` enums of specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/workflow.schema.json (the node branch and the shared property definition), keeping apiVersion sagat-octopus-orchestrator.io/v1 (ADR-0032). The field stays informational: the runner takes the language from the signed artifact (005 G106). Publication additionally refuses a script node whose pinned artifact's language is disabled by the namespace script runtime policy, with publication error code SCRIPT_LANGUAGE_DISABLED; that check reads the artifact row, not this field. At run time the engine also refuses to lease a step whose artifact language is disabled, failing it as non-retryable SCRIPT_DENIED with an audit record (FR-023-017).

scriptLanguage.description: Informational: the runner takes the language from the artifact. python-data is reserved for the image-catalog runtime of feature 024 (FR-023-027).

x-publication-errors.meaning: A script node pins a ready artifact of the tenant whose language the namespace script runtime policy disables. Same severity as UNKNOWN_SCRIPT; the message names the node id, never the source.
